title: DECISION RECORD
rule: the portfolio is indexed by decisions, not by projects
description: Ten decisions from five years of web and mobile work, written as decision records: Context, Decision, Consequence, a year, a scope and a status. The work sits under each record as evidence.
signature: Public Sans with one mono for ids and years, on white paper, with one green that only means Accepted. A dense decision log on the left, the open record on the right. Open a record whose Context states a number and that number leaves the Context sentence and lands in the Consequence, counting on the way (16 → 2 queries, React Native 0.63 → 0.81). A superseded record is joined to the record that replaced it by a 1 px bracket in the log gutter, drawn from the open record toward the other. Keyboard and reduced motion change state with no travel.
holdback: Lowest: hooks people and original, 6/10 each. The memorable moment (the 16 leaves the Context sentence and lands in the Consequence as 2) only plays when a visitor opens 0009 or 0003; the first screen shows a calm log, the open 0010 record and a 1 px bracket that draws to 0004, which is easy to miss. Visually the page is a master-detail reader (list left, record right), close to a docs or mail layout; the idea (a portfolio indexed by decisions) is new, the frame is not. The live care recreation also brings its own teal palette and type into the record, a second design language beside the one green.
